note: The gate. A command's recorded cases run when its name appears in `activated`, and not otherwise; adding a name is an approval act that judges whether the recorded output is good. Every command the binary had at the pin sits in exactly ONE of three disjoint categories: `activatable` has cases and can be approved; `unseeded` carries no behavior at the pin, so there is nothing to approve and no activation path exists; `unrecorded` has behavior but no case exercises it. `activated` is not a fourth category — it is the subset of `activatable` whose cases run, and it is empty. See docs/decisions/0001-corpus-activation-gate.md.

unrecorded.reason: the registry namespace is a late addition at the pin; the case catalog covers it only indirectly, through the top-level help page and one behavior ruling, so no invocation of it was recorded
